title: BREAKING: በአዲስ አበባ አዲስ የምድር መንሸራተት ተመዘገበ | Landslide in Addis Ababa
description: Emergency response teams are on site after a significant landslide occurred in the Kolfe Keranio district of Addis Ababa. The incident has affected several homes and infrastructure. Rescue operations are underway to ensure resident safety. Authorities are assessing the damage and providing emergency shelter to affected families.
author: Abbay TV Emergency Desk

title: Ethiopian Government Announces New Economic Reform Package
description: The Ministry of Finance has unveiled a comprehensive economic reform package aimed at stabilizing the Ethiopian economy. The reforms include currency adjustments, export incentives, and foreign investment policies. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed emphasized the government's commitment to economic growth and poverty reduction.
author: Economic Bureau

title: አባይ ቴሌቪዥን አዲስ የጠዋት ዜና ፕሮግራም ጀምሯል | Abbay TV Launches Morning News
description: አባይ ቴሌቪዥን አዲስ የጠዋት ዜና ፕሮግራም 'ኢትዮጵያ ጠዋት'ን በተሳካ ሁኔታ ጀምሯል። ፕሮግራሙ ከጠዋት 6 እስከ 12 ሰዓት ድረስ የተለያዩ ዜናዎችን፣ የአየር ሁኔታን እና ልዩ ቃለ መጠይቆችን ያቀርባል። ይህ አዲሱ ፕሮግራም ሰፊ የተመልካች አስተያየት እየተጋለጠለት ነው።
author: Abbay TV News Team

title: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ አዲስ የንግድ ስምምነት ተፈረመ | East Africa Trade Agreement
description: Ethiopia, Kenya, Somalia, and Djibouti have signed a new regional trade agreement aimed at boosting economic integration. The agreement reduces tariffs, simplifies customs procedures, and promotes cross-border investments. The deal is expected to increase regional trade by 30% over the next three years.
author: International Desk
